intro: Razzle Sprysprocket is a gnomish engineer residing in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Known for his technical tinkering alongside Ozzie Togglevolt, he enlists travelers to help salvage disrupted gnomish machinery and components around the snowy hills.

p: Following the tragedy at Gnomeregan, Razzle Sprysprocket found refuge among the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh, setting up his workshop in Kharanos. With a knack for delicate mechanical parts, Razzle works alongside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Their efforts frequently involve recovering gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies that were lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland.

Life in Dun Morogh is far from peaceful for a gnome inventor. Between the wild beasts of the frozen ridges and raids by local Frostmane trolls, Razzle's work is never entirely safe. Despite the dangers, he remains dedicated to keeping gnomish contraptions functional and recovering the lost wonders of Gnomeregan.
